articles.title_original: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa
articles.title_zh: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa
facts_zh: String of female murder victims found near Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week The discovery of the bodies of eight women around Johannesburg’s international airport, including five in the past week, has prompted an outpouring of fear, grief and anger over a lack of progress in tackling femicide.
When Elizabeth “Tsontso” Moselakgomo did not return after going for a run on 9 September, her eight-year-old daughter alerted relatives, who contacted police.
The 38-year-old’s body was found on Saturday and identified by relatives on Monday.

all_titles.en: ‘We are prey’: discovery of seven women’s bodies fuels anger over femicide in South Africa

articles.title_original: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
articles.title_zh: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
facts_zh:
Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
- Published
The leaders of eight German states have backed the nation's chancellor amid growing speculation about his political future.

The premiers - all of whom are part of Friedrich Merz's Christian Democratic Union (CDU) - wrote that restoring trust in their party lay in "listening and taking political action, not in debates over personnel".

Merz, who has only held the post for 16 months, is facing poor approval ratings while the anti-immigration, far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party is surging, prompting questions about whether he is an electoral liability.

all_titles.en: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future

articles.title_original: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
articles.title_zh: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
facts_zh:
US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination
- Published
The US has announced visa restrictions targeting people it accuses of discriminating against South Africa's white minority, in the latest escalation of tensions between the two countries.

The Trump administration has criticised South Africa over several issues, including policies aimed at addressing racial inequality that it says discriminate against Afrikaners, descendants mainly of Dutch and French settlers.
South Africa has repeatedly denied the claim.

all_titles.en: US limits visas for South African officials over alleged anti-white discrimination

articles.title_zh: Russische Sprengstoffdrohne vor polnischer Ostseeküste entdeckt
facts_zh:
Nahe Badeort Rusinowo Russische Sprengstoffdrohne vor polnischer Ostseeküste entdeckt
Erneut ist auf Nato-Territorium eine russische Sprengstoffdrohne entdeckt worden: Polnische Streitkräfte fischten das Fluggerät am Montag vor der Küste des Landes aus der Ostsee.
Die Drohne vom Typ Gerbera-2 sei mit einem »Gefechtskopf mit Zünder« ausgestattet gewesen, erklärte nun der Militärstaatsanwalt Bartosz Okoniewski.
Es liefen Ermittlungen unter dem Verdacht der Gefährdung »von Leben oder Gesundheit vieler Menschen sowie von Eigentum von großem Wert«.

facts_zh:
Legendary Nigerian actor Olu Jacobs dies aged 84
- Published
Olu Jacobs, one of Nigeria's best known actors, whose career spanned several decades across theatre, television and film, has died at the age of 84.
His wife, veteran actress Joke Silva, announced his death and asked for privacy while the family mourns.
Silva announced his passing in a statement describing the celebrated actor as "The Lion of Lufodo" and saying his life was "well lived and fought".

articles.title_original: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
articles.title_zh: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
facts_zh: Passionate documentary maker won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85.
According to Chilean news outlet Emol , Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president.

all_titles.en: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85

Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney last week spoke of seeking a "unique alliance" with the EU.

articles.source: ウクルインフォルム通信
facts_zh:
ロシア軍、ウクライナ南部ニコポリ地区のバスを無人機で攻撃 ５名死亡、７名負傷
ウクルインフォルム
    ウクライナへの全面侵略を続けるロシア軍は１６日、同国南部ドニプロペトロウシク州ニコポリ地区にて無人機でバスを攻撃した。これにより５名が死亡、７名が負傷した。
ハンジャ・ドニプロペトロウシク州軍行政府長官がテレグラム・チャンネルで報告した。
ハンジャ氏は、「ロシア軍人がバスに無人機を狙った。５名がその場で死亡した。７名の負傷者は現在医師が診ている。彼らには必要な全ての支援が提供されている」と伝えた。

articles.title_zh: Philippines' Duterte seen in person at International Criminal Court for first time
facts_zh:
Philippines' Duterte seen in person at International Criminal Court for first time
- Published
Former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte has appeared in person at the International Criminal Court in The Hague, where he is due to be tried for alleged crimes against humanity.
He is facing charges over his bloody war on drugs, which saw tens of thousands of small-time drug dealers allegedly executed summarily.
The 81-year-old wore a dark suit and white shirt on Wednesday, which marked the first time he has been seen in person since his arrest in Manila 18 months ago.

facts_zh:
El dron derribado por la OTAN en Lituania estaba cargado con explosivos
Al igual que el reciente intento fallido de ataque en el aeropuerto de Leipzig, el objetivo de este dron era una infraestructura clave, la planta hidroeléctrica de Krunonis
Corresponsal en Berlín
Los pilotos de los cazas italianos de la OTAN que derribaron el dron que había entrado en el espacio aéreo lituano, en la madrugada del martes, lo sospecharon desde que tuvieron contacto visual con el objeto volador no tripulado.
Ahora lo confirma el ministro ...

de Defensa de Lituania, Robertas Kaunas: el nuevo dron interceptado cerca de la central de bombeo de Kruonis, la única planta hidroeléctrica de almacenamiento por bombeo de todo el Báltico, portaba una carga explosiva que fue hallada entre los restos del aparato y desactivada por fuerzas especiales.

articles.title_original: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
articles.title_zh: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
facts_zh:
Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says
- Published
Colombia has again topped the list of countries with the highest number of killings of land and environmental activists, according to an annual report by campaign group Global Witness, external.
Out of at least 124 activists killed globally in 2025, 39 were murdered in Colombia, followed by Brazil with 26.
Global Witness says that 85% of the documented killings took place in Latin America, making it the deadliest region for every year since the group started publishing its reports in 2012.

all_titles.en: Colombia and Brazil deadliest countries for environmental activists, report says

مصافي اليابان تسارع لشراء نفط الشرق الأوسط بعد تعطل مسار إمدادات سعودي
كثفت مصافي التكرير اليابانية مشترياتها من نفط الشرق الأوسط، مع تصاعد المخاوف بشأن سرعة وصول الإمدادات بعد إغلاق خط أنابيب سعودي رئيسي، وسط منافسة متزايدة بين المشترين الآسيويين للحصول على شحنات الخام المتاحة.
وذكرت بلومبيرغ، نقلا عن متعاملين مطلعين، أن شركتي إينيوس هولدينغز وإديميتسو كوسان اليابانيتين اشترتا مؤخرا خاما عمانيا للتحميل في أكتوبر/تشرين الأول، في خطوة جاءت أبكر من المعتاد.

articles.title_zh: España asume el liderazgo de una fuerza naval de la OTAN en el Atlántico Norte
facts_zh: España ha asumido desde el pasado 1 de julio el mando de una de las fuerzas navales regionales de la OTAN encargadas de la vigilancia del Atlántico Norte, responsabilidad que mantendrá hasta el 30 de junio de 2027.
Es la primera ocasión en la que la Armada española desempeña este cometido, en un contexto marcado por el refuerzo de la seguridad del flanco norte de la Alianza.

El mando ha sido confiado al vicealmirante Juan Bautista Pérez Puig, comandante del Cuartel General Marítimo de Alta Disponibilidad español y del Spanish Maritime Forces Headquarters (SPMARFOR), que ejerce como comandante de la fuerza multinacional durante este periodo.

articles.title_original: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
articles.title_zh: Slave-trade wealth was embedded in Britain’s financial system, research finds
facts_zh: Dozens of Bank of England directors and founding subscribers invested in trafficking of enslaved Africans The Bank of England and the British financial system were for centuries deeply involved in the enslavement and transatlantic trafficking of millions of African people, according to new research on Britain’s slavery history.
Research by historians compiling the Register of British Slave Traders has found that the scale of the financial system’s involvement in enslavement is greater than previously known or acknowledged.

The Bank of England, the central bank owned by the government since nationalisation by Clement Attlee’s Labour administration in 1946, had dozens of financiers involved in its foundation who were also significant investors in the transatlantic trafficking of enslaved Africans.

articles.title_zh: ポーランド、ウクライナ国境の警備を強化 ロシアの相次ぐ攻撃でNATO加盟国に懸念
facts_zh:
ポーランド、ウクライナ国境の警備を強化 ロシアの相次ぐ攻撃でNATO加盟国に懸念
（CNN） ポーランドのコシニャクカミシュ国防相は15日、国境検問所付近へのロシアの相次ぐドローン（無人機）攻撃で北大西洋条約機構（NATO）加盟国の懸念が高まったことを受け、ウクライナ国境の警備を強化していると発表した。
コシニャクカミシュ氏はX（旧ツイッター）への投稿で「ここ数日の状況は、ロシアの行動で欧州全体の安全が脅かされていることを示している。政府の決定に従い、国境警備隊の使用するインフラの強化が進められている」と述べた。先週末に発生した2回の攻撃を受けたもので、うち1回は欧米の元高官らが移動に使っていた列車に着弾した。
ロシア国防省は15日、ポーランド国境付近へ2回の攻撃を行ったことを確認。軍事物資を輸送する列車だったと主張した。

all_titles.ja: ポーランド、ウクライナ国境の警備を強化 ロシアの相次ぐ攻撃でNATO加盟国に懸念

- Published
All of the remaining support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour have quit, after the rapper Macklemore was dropped from the line-up for making pro-Palestinian remarks on stage.

Among them were Finneas, the brother of pop star Billie Eilish, who said in a statement: "Artists must not be silenced when they speak up for the oppressed."
Irish singer-songwriter Aaron Rowe and Danish band Lukas Graham also announced their departure.
Irish folk band Beoga, who perform with Sheeran on stage every night, dropped out too.

articles.title_original: منتزه مليحة الوطني «أفضل منتزه وطني في الشرق الأوسط 2026»
articles.title_zh: منتزه مليحة الوطني «أفضل منتزه وطني في الشرق الأوسط 2026»
facts_zh:
الشارقة (وام) 
حصد منتزه مليحة الوطني جائزة «أفضل منتزه وطني في الشرق الأوسط لعام 2026» ضمن فعاليات الدورة الـ33 من جوائز السفر العالمية؛ تقديراً لما يقدمه المنتزه من مزيج فريد يجمع بين الإرث الأثري والمناظر الطبيعية الخلابة والسياحة البيئية والتجارب الاستكشافية التي تأخذ الزوار في رحلة غامرة في قلب الصحراء.

جاء هذا الفوز في فئة شديدة التنافسية وسط منافسة قوية مع أربعة منتزهات أخرى فقط في المنطقة ضمتها القائمة القصيرة للجائزة ليؤكد التزام منتزه مليحة الوطني الراسخ بالحفاظ على الإرث الأثري الغني للمنطقة مع تقديمه في الوقت ذاته تجارب سياحية بيئية وتعليمية بمستوى عالمي حيث تُعد جوائز السفر العالمية التي انطلقت عام 1993 مرجعاً معتمداً للتميز في قطاعات السفر والسياحة والضيافة على مستوى العالم.

وقال عمر آل علي مدير مليحة والمشاريع الإستراتيجية: نفخر بحصد هذا التكريم الذي يُعد محطة مهمة في مسيرة منتزه مليحة الوطني، ويأتي ثمرة للدعم الذي لمسناه من زوارنا وشركائنا ومجتمعنا، فمليحة وجهة يلتقي فيها التاريخ بالطبيعة والاكتشاف، وسنواصل السعي لتقديم تجارب تُقرّب الناس أكثر من هذا المكان الاستثنائي وتُطلع زوارنا من دولة الإمارات ومختلف أنحاء العالم على عمق إرث الشارقة.

all_titles.ar: منتزه مليحة الوطني «أفضل منتزه وطني في الشرق الأوسط 2026»

British woman abducted in Malawi, police say
- Published
Police in Malawi are investigating the kidnapping of a British national who was abducted in the southern African nation's main city, Blantyre.
Nusrat Osman, 47, was seized at around 12:30 local time on Friday by four men who had been travelling in a grey Nissan Dualis, according to a police statement.

The authorities have offered a reward of more than $17,000 (£12,600) for "credible information" that could lead to the rescue of the mother of two young children and the prosecution of the perpetrators.

Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
- Published
Parts of the Netherlands, including Amsterdam, were hit by major rail disruption after suspected sabotage to the tracks on Tuesday morning, the country's railway infrastructure operator said.
ProRail said pipes and cables were laid on tracks at multiple locations in the country's centre and north in more than 35 incidents.
It added the acts appeared to be intentional, causing widespread cancellations and delays, with new disruptions occurring in some places after objects had initially been removed.

Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
- Published
Two sailors are missing and 23 others have been rescued following an attack on an oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, Oman says.

Oman's Maritime Security Centre said the Panama-flagged El Gaia was being towed to an Omani port on Tuesday after a fire broke out in its engine room, adding that the vessel was targeted 1.3 nautical miles (2.4km) north of the Musandam peninsula.
On Monday, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said the tanker hit naval mines and caught fire while passing through what they described as a restricted and unsafe route.

articles.title_zh: Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport
facts_zh:
Ash from Mount Etna grounds flights at Sicily airport
- Published
All flights have been suspended from one of Italy's busiest airports because of volcanic ash released from nearby Mount Etna.

It is the second time in recent months that Catania International Airport, on the island of Sicily, has stopped flights due to emissions from Etna, which is Europe's tallest active volcano and erupts frequently.
Airport officials said arrivals and departures, which were first halted on Monday, would be suspended until 22:00 (20:00 GMT) on Tuesday.

Ce que l'on sait du drone abattu par l'Otan au-dessus de la Lituanie
Deux avions de chasse italiens, en mission pour l'Alliance atlantique, ont abattu dans la nuit de lundi à mardi un drone d'origine indéterminée au-dessus de la Lituanie.
La Russie, soupçonnée de précédentes intrusions similaires en Europe, n'a pas commenté l'incident.

articles.title_zh: More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older
facts_zh:
More than 100,000 people in Japan are now aged 100 or older
- Published
The number of people aged 100 or more in Japan has exceeded 100,000 for the first time, according to the health ministry.
Figures show Japan is now home to 107,677 centenarians, the highest number in the world, of whom 88% are women.
The oldest woman is Kishimoto Fuyo, a 114-year-old from Kyoto City and the oldest man is Kato Hikaru, a 112-year-old from Kumamoto.
